name: Slower hyperdrive spool
description: A gameplay change (set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page, off by default): every ship's hyperdrive takes hyperjumpSpoolFactor (3) times as long to spool up before a jump (the original's jump initiation time, about 5 to 15 seconds, becomes about 15 to 45). All ships of every empire, pirates and the player alike; the jump itself, its speed and its exit are unchanged. With Defensive jump interdiction an interdicted ship's spool is that add-on's total (5 times the original), not stacked on top.

params.name: hyperjumpSpoolFactor
params.label: Hyperjump spool (jump initiation) takes this many times as long as in the original
